dct_title_s: Map no. 2 of the El Paso & Fort Yuma wagon road: 1857-8

dct_description_sm: Shows the road from San Diego to the Pimo Villages northwest of Tucson. Also shows old road, water, mail stations, Indian trails, and routes pursued by exploring parties of the Engineer Corps.; Relief shown by hachures.; "(Sen. Ex. Doc. no. 36 - Ho. Ex. Doc. no. 108 - 2d Sess. : 35 Cong.)."
